description: Fix all frontend security issues (M-1, M-2, M-3, L-2, L-3) across AuthContext.jsx, useAuthRefresh.js, StaffGuard.jsx, and AdminPage.jsx
steps: M-1: In apps/frontend/src/context/AuthContext.jsx, make authHeader reactive. Add a [token, setToken] = useState(getToken) state. Call setToken(access_token) inside login() and signup() after storeToken(). Call setToken(newToken) in fetchMe() after silentRefresh() succeeds. Call setToken(null) in logout() after clearTokens(). In the context value, change authHeader from getToken() ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${getToken()}` } : {} to token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}. Also expose token from state instead of getToken().

M-2: In apps/frontend/src/hooks/useAuthRefresh.js withRefresh function, remove the newToken argument from the second requestFn call. Change 'return await requestFn(newToken)' to 'return await requestFn()'. The caller must use getToken() internally after silentRefresh updates the stored token.

M-3: In apps/frontend/src/components/StaffGuard.jsx, remove '&& !user.is_admin' from the guard condition on line 27. The condition should just be: if (role !== 'staff' && role !== 'admin'). The is_admin field does not exist in the UserProfile schema so it is always undefined/falsy.

L-2: In apps/frontend/src/context/AuthContext.jsx logout function, add error handling to the catch block. Currently it's an empty catch {}. Change to: catch (err) { try { Analytics.track('logout_backend_error', { status: err?.response?.status }); } catch {} }. Analytics is already imported from '@/utils/analytics' at the top of the file.

L-3: In apps/frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.jsx, remove the adminToken state variable (line 160: const [adminToken, setAdminToken] = useState(null)). Instead, since the admin auth uses httponly cookies (withCredentials:true), replace all uses of adminToken with a simple boolean verified state. Rename setAdminToken(null) calls to setVerified(false) and setAdminToken('verified') to setVerified(true). Then pass withCredentials:true (which is already in the API utility functions) instead of token. Keep passing a dummy adminToken prop as a truthy value (e.g. 'cookie') to child components that check for it as a boolean gate -- OR better: since the existing code already sets adminToken to the string 'verified', just keep a verified boolean and pass verified ? 'cookie' : null to maintain backward compat. Actually reviewing the code more carefully: adminToken is set to 'verified' (a string) and passed to child components. Since this is used as a truthy check in children, the simplest fix is to remove the state entirely and derive it from verifying state. Replace [adminToken, setAdminToken] with a derived const: const adminToken = verifying ? null : 'cookie'. Remove all setAdminToken calls. The adminGetUnacknowledgedAlertCount and adminGetSettings calls already pass withCredentials:true via the api.jsx utility (adminHeaders returns {} when token is not a real JWT).
acceptance_criteria: AuthContext exposes a reactive authHeader that updates when token changes
withRefresh does not pass token argument to the retry requestFn call
Logout catch block logs error via Analytics.track
AdminPage does not have useState for adminToken; derives it from verification state
All JSX files have no syntax errors (verified by vite build)
